A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the card-type bar, the game-text box and the numbers beside it) with the corrected game text, and below it a black strip with the title and a white E, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its Decipher Errata sheet dated 1 January 2013.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-D-mournfulroar-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Mournful Roar]] (Decipher, November 1996): The game text now reads: “Deploy on Chewie if Han was just lost or just became missing. Opponent cannot play Let The Wookiee Win or Wookiee Roar. Opponent must also lose 1 Force at end of every player’s turn. If Han on table, Effect canceled.” The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “•Mournful Roar” and a white italic “E”. The slip prints the card type as “EFFECT” (the card is an Immediate Effect).

The lower part of the earlier card image (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
